en.headline: RTHK senior editor given 160 hours community service for upskirt filming
en.dek: Chong Tak-yin, 57, pleaded guilty to unlawful recording of intimate parts after police found a video of a woman in Mong Kok last November.
body: A senior editor at Radio Television Hong Kong was sentenced to 160 hours of community service at West Kowloon Magistrates’ Courts on Wednesday after pleading guilty to filming up a woman’s skirt.

Chong Tak-yin, 57, assistant chief assignment editor at RTHK’s Chinese news and current affairs division, admitted one count of unlawful recording or observation of intimate parts. Police officers on patrol in Mong Kok on 14 November 2025 noticed him following a woman and holding his phone at an angle beneath her skirt; a 17-second video of the woman’s underwear was found on his phone.

Under caution he said the act was a momentary lapse driven by sexual impulse. Magistrate Jeffrey Sze accepted positive probation and community service reports noting genuine remorse, a stable family and low risk of reoffending.

zh.headline: 港台助理總採訪主任偷拍裙底 判160小時社服令
zh.dek: 57歲莊德賢承認非法拍攝私密部位罪，去年11月在旺角被巡邏警員揭發。
body: 香港電台助理總採訪主任莊德賢（57歲）承認一項非法拍攝或觀察私密部位罪，星期三在西九龍裁判法院被判160小時社會服務令。
案情指，去年11月14日下午巡邏警員在旺角通菜街發現被告行為鬼祟，手持電話緊隨一名穿短裙女子並以45度角貼近其下身。截查後在其手機發現17秒裙底片段。
被告在警誡下承認因一時性衝動犯案。裁判官施祖堯接納感化及社服報告，指被告有悔意、家庭穩定及再犯風險低。
